mdqda.description: Markdown qualitative data analysis (QDA) extension: generate Foam/Obsidian-compatible block IDs and block references for Markdown paragraphs, copy them to the clipboard or append them to a target document; the Block Reference Library sidebar manages coded snippets and the Code Manager manages code files in a coding folder (create / rename / merge / delete / export codebook).
mdqda.view.blockRefLibrary.name: Block Reference Library
mdqda.view.codeManager.name: Code Manager
mdqda.welcome.blockRefLibrary:
No block references found in the workspace Markdown files.

Use **QDA: Copy Block Reference** (`Ctrl+Alt+B`) on any Markdown paragraph and this view will list all text snippets that have a block ID. Right-click a snippet to organize it into a folder.
mdqda.welcome.codeManager:
The coding folder currently has no Markdown files.

A code is a .md file in the coding folder whose content is a list of block references (append with `Ctrl+Alt+B`).

Click the folder icon in the view title bar to **select the coding folder** (defaults to the workspace root), or click + to create a new code.
mdqda.config.title: QDA Block Reference
mdqda.config.codingFolder: Coding folder scanned by the Code Manager (relative path from the workspace root; empty = workspace root)
